cohort_arc: The old order breaks: millennial dread, stage theory, the agrarian precedent, politics dying. Ink arc gold → copper → verdigris → oxide.

contract.merge: Supervisor merges src(=asset)/class/motif/caption sequentially per READER-CONTRACT §4.
contract.note: Plate files art/plate-p1c1..p1c4.svg are the engineer's build target from cohort-a.design.md §8; this draft records the contract fields.

p1c1.caption: Plate I · The millennium asymptote
p1c1.opener: Asymmetric plate rail: #chapter-art holds the asymptote plate (12-petal Specie guilloche, central curve-to-vertical graph vignette with 2000 wall + 500/1000/1500 cycle ticks, APOKALYPSIS microtext ring, I cartouches) left ~38%; title block right. <900px: 320px banner slice. Prototype-first deliverable.
p1c1.palette_role: Gold-dominant announcement ink; copper vignette rules; bone microtext.
p1c1.rationale: Opens on the year-2000 asymptote itself: Hillis epigraph [0], Newton/Nostradamus/Jung forecasts [1-2], Apokalypsis-as-unveiling [4], four stages [8], 500-year cycle [~200-210]. The curve-to-vertical is the chapter's own central graph.
p1c1.reading: Drop cap where applicable (.no-drop on quote-led [0] by design); epigraph [0] framed; caps heads [6,26,49,71,96,157]; title heads [13,19,29,34,40,86,101,112,150]; pull [66] 'Soon, the cows will have wings.' framed; Cohen/Stewart quote [110-111] reunited; end-mark I — ASSAYED.
p1c1.title: The Transition in the Year 2000

p1c2.caption: Plate II · Four stages of society
p1c2.opener: Plate rail: strata plate (4-layer 6/7/5/8-petal copper rosette, stacked-band vignette with gold fourth band, megapolitical-variables microtext ring, II cartouches) left; title block right. <900px banner slice.
p1c2.palette_role: Copper-dominant earth/archive ink; gold reserved for the fourth band.
p1c2.rationale: 'Waning of the Modern Age' historicized through megapolitical stages: Huizinga epigraph [0-1], foraging→farming→industrial→information, four variables (topography [89], climate [96-97], microbes, technology), summary points [71-79].
p1c2.reading: Epigraph [0-1] paired frame; caps heads [2,55,87,125] (L1FE [55] set as-served); title heads [48,60,80,137]; summary points [71-79] as engraved ledger rows; enumerators [114,117,119,121] as mono run-in labels; end-mark II — ASSAYED.
p1c2.title: Megapolitical Transformations in Historical Perspective

p1c3.caption: Plate III · The first furrow
p1c3.opener: Plate rail: furrow plate (8-petal verdigris rosette stretched 1.28×, perspective furrow-field vignette with seed dots, sweat-of-thy-face microtext ring, III cartouches) left; title block right. <900px banner slice.
p1c3.palette_role: Verdigris-dominant — the first green chapter (S3: ch. 3 & 7 only); bone microtext.
p1c3.rationale: The Agricultural Revolution as slow-motion violence-logic shift: Genesis field-inscription [0], stakes-and-hoes [1], PROPERTY [41], the stirrup passage [91], PARADISE LOST [128], sweat-of-thy-face [134]. Furrows are the chapter's paradigm image.
p1c3.reading: Drop cap on [0] (long field-head para, no epigraph frame); caps heads [41,67,128]; title heads [23,51,77]; stirrup tech-card [91]; figures tabular-nums in body serif; end-mark III — ASSAYED.
p1c3.title: East of Eden

p1c4.caption: Plate IV · The fallen capital
p1c4.opener: Plate rail: fallen-capital plate (9-petal copper rosette + displaced seal-red echo petal, toppled-capital vignette with gold abacus fragment + fracture line, A-TIME-MUCH-LIKE-NOW microtext ring, IV cartouches) left; title block right. <900px banner slice.
p1c4.palette_role: Copper/oxide decay inks; gold only in the intact fragment; seal-red fracture echo + ledger stamps (graphics only).
p1c4.rationale: 'Death of politics' paralleled with the senile Church: Clarke epigraph [0], politics dates to 1529 [2], scandal roll call [6-7], chivalry→citizenship [31ff], press solvent [~100], indulgences/ballad [147-163], 'A time much like now' [234].

p1c4.title: The Last Days of Politics
